test_input: Hold RIGHT for 120 frames, then repeatedly press SPACE every 60 frames until WIN or GAME OVER is displayed. Press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.
notes:
Controls (exact printed lines):
- Left arrow: prints 'MOVE LEFT' when pressed (held movement).
- Right arrow: prints 'MOVE RIGHT' when pressed (held movement).
- Up arrow: prints 'JUMP' when pressed and the player is on the floor.
- Space: prints 'PUNCH' when pressed and punch starts (subject to cooldown).
- R: prints 'RESTART' and resets fighters and health.
- Escape or window close: prints 'QUIT' and exits.
- When the fight ends: prints 'WIN' (rival defeated) or 'GAME OVER' (player defeated).

Gameplay notes and limitations:
- The game uses the supplied PNG assets in game/assets (red_belt_fighter.png and blue_belt_fighter.png). No sounds are implemented per Plan.
- Damage is 10 per successful punch; each fighter starts at 100 health. Health bars are shown at the top of the screen.
- Punches create an immediate knockback by moving the opponent's x-position by a fixed amount; this is an instant position shift, not a physics impulse.
- Hit flash is implemented by drawing a semi-transparent white overlay for a short time.
- Rival AI walks toward the player and punches when within AI_PUNCH_DISTANCE with a ~1.0s cooldown between punches.
- Restart (R) fully resets positions, health and timers. After WIN/GAME OVER the game is frozen until restart.
- Performance: the game runs at 60 FPS when possible; movement and gravity scale with dt.

Files implementing behavior:
- game/main.py: main loop, event handling, drawing, health bars, floor, window title, restart/quit, prints.
- game/fighter.py: Fighter class implementing movement, gravity, jump, punching, hit detection, knockback and flash.
- game/constants.py: all tunable constants (sizes, colors, physics and timings).

Exact play sequence to reproduce: open the game, hold Right to approach the rival, press Space when in range to hit. Repeat until rival health reaches 0 (WIN) or player reaches 0 (GAME OVER). Press R to restart or ESC to quit.
